messages:
rahul: Heads-up: discovered header-key normalization mismatch between router v3.5.0 and runtime v2.10.0 during canary. Change window tonight 21:30 UTC. Need decision: temporary pin router or proceed with conservative rollout? @becca @mike
becca: Saw the same in staging. ~0.2% of requests get remapped keys when prefix cache hits; those flows show p95 +140ms. Functionally ok but noisy.
mike: Console implications? Metric names and panels could misattribute traffic if headers differ.
console-bot: Alert: panel mapping 'router.incoming.headers' expects legacy header name. Affected: /dash/ux/latency. Suggest short-lived alias shim if we don't pin.
rahul: Two choices: 1) pin router to v3.4.x for tonight and open RW-3550 to re-roll after runtime patch; 2) go ahead with v3.5.0 but start at 0.05% canary, tightened timeouts, and auto-rollback rules.
becca: I prefer pin (option 1) to avoid mid-window dashboard churn and tail latency risk. Operational overhead minimal.
sre-oncall: If we pin, define rollback/watch rules for runtime too. If we don't pin, I'll need aggressive auto-rollback: error_rate >0.7% over 5m OR p99 +200ms OR canary error >0.5% within 10m. Also pre-define owners for rollback.
deploybot: Running quick preflight for window 1767001111 (2026-03-25T21:30:00Z). Services: api, runtime, console, router.
deploybot: Preflight summary:
```
api: OK
runtime v2.10.0: WARN - kv_eviction_rate spike in staging
console: WARN - panel alias mismatch
router v3.5.0: OK
canary-sim @0.5% -> 1x 499, 1x 408 over 5m
```
Note: client timeouts correlate with eviction spikes. Recommend defensive plan.
mike: Can we do a targeted sim with prefix caching disabled to confirm?
becca: I'll run that now and report back; early results show drop in 499s.
rahul: OK decision: temporary pin router -> v3.4.9 for tonight; schedule follow-up RW-3550 to roll to v3.5.0 after runtime kernel tuning. Rollback triggers (for any change): auto-rollback if error_rate >= 0.8% over 5m OR p99 latency increase >= 250ms over baseline OR canary 0.05% sees >0.5% errors. Manual rollback allowed for SEV.
deploybot: Pin command queued:
```
./deployctl pin service=router variant=v3.4.9 --window=2026-03-25T21:30:00Z --owner=rahul --note="temp pin for runtime compat"
```
console-bot: Creating metric alias shim and adding release-note blurb referencing RW-3550.
sre-oncall: I'll add deploybot rollback rules and set on-call watch for T+0..30m. Also prepare quick rollback commands and owners in runbook.
becca: Follow-up sim with caching disabled shows 0x 499s in 5m run. Looks like eviction interacts with prefix cache.
rahul: Thanks. Everyone react :thumbsup: if agreed.
mike: :thumbsup:
becca: +1
sre-oncall: :thumbsup:
deploybot: Pin scheduled and preflight recorded. Change window set for 2026-03-25T21:30:00Z.
rahul: Will update release notes and notify product. Opening RW-3550 for kernel tuning and a re-roll plan. Will post final status when pin is live.
